name: modscope-bisect
description: Companion to modscope: skips user-tier mods via next.to for bisection. Requires seating in prependPlugins (or appendPlugins). Disabled unless 'enabled' is set.

enabled.title: Bypass mods
enabled.description: When true and this plugin is seated via prependPlugins, every event jumps past user (and append) mods to 'builtin'; target 'core' skips builtin too.

target.title: Jump target tier
target.description: 'builtin' keeps built-in mods (e.g. sec-default) active; 'core' skips every mod beneath. Append-seated installs may only target 'core'.
